workflow_meta.name: Storyline Subflow (auto pipeline)
workflow_meta.description: Storyline 子流程静态快照。2026-11-14 依赖约简阶段1 已同步当前 graph.py 的 17 节点拓扑(单源链 GV→SB→RTR→GAT / PTP 两源 fan-in / 条件路由 / QA 重试回路);仅为示意,权威接线以 graph.py 与 tests 为准。本文件无 edges 数组:连接由 dependencies(数据来源,屏障即全部源)与 next_nodes(下游,含条件出口)双向表达。

nodes.name: Load Media
nodes.description: Loads and indexes input media. Entry point with no dependencies; required by all downstream operations.

input_schema.name: mode
input_schema.description: auto: Automatic mode; skip: Skip mode; default: Default mode

output_schema.name: media
output_schema.description: List of media objects with metadata

nodes.name: Split Shots
nodes.description: Automatically segment videos into shots based on scene changes; treat images as single shots.

input_schema.name: mode
input_schema.description: auto: Automatically segment shots based on scene changes, treat images as single shots; skip: Do not segment shots; default: Use default segmentation method

input_schema.name: min_shot_duration
input_schema.description: Segmented shots must not be shorter than this duration (milliseconds)

input_schema.name: max_shot_duration
input_schema.description: If a single shot exceeds this duration, force segmentation (milliseconds)

output_schema.name: clip_captions
output_schema.description: List of clips after splitting shots

nodes.name: Understand Clips
nodes.description: Generate descriptions/captions for each clip based on media content.

input_schema.name: mode
input_schema.description: auto: Generate descriptions based on media content; skip: Do not generate descriptions; default: Use default description generation method

output_schema.name: clip_captions
output_schema.description: List of clips after understanding clips

nodes.name: Filter Clips
nodes.description: Filter clips based on user requirements.

input_schema.name: mode
input_schema.description: auto: Filter clips based on user requirements; skip: Skip filtering; default: Use default filtering method

input_schema.name: user_request
input_schema.description: User's requirements for clip filtering; if none provided, formulate one based on materials and other editing requirements.

nodes.name: Group Clips
nodes.description: Organize clips into narrative groups and arrange playback order. QA 时长超限且仍可重试时,由 storyline_qa_gate 的条件回边重新触发(重试回路起点,非数据依赖)。作为模板推荐主链的分组来源(2026-11-14 依赖约简:BGM/转场/AI 转场/时间线不再把分组列为直接屏障来源,由保留链传递保证)。

input_schema.name: mode
input_schema.description: auto: Organize clips in a logical order based on narrative flow and user's sequencing requirements; skip: Skip sorting; default: Use default ordering method

input_schema.name: user_request
input_schema.description: User's requirements for media organization order; if none provided, arrange in a logical narrative sequence following standard conventions.

output_schema.name: groups
output_schema.description: List of clip groups with ordering and summaries

nodes.name: Recommend Script Template
nodes.description: Recommend/select a copywriting template based on material content and user's requirements. 2026-11-14 依赖约简阶段5:文案生成的主链前置节点,与检索节点并行 fan-out;经 [template_recommendation, search_web_topic]→generate_script 双源屏障汇入文案(原出口条件路由已删)。

input_schema.name: mode
input_schema.description: auto: Select an appropriate copywriting template based on the material content and user's requirements for voiceover style; skip: Skip;

input_schema.name: user_request
input_schema.description: User's specific requirements for the script style.

input_schema.name: filter_include
input_schema.description: Positive filter conditions. Multiple dimensions are combined with AND, multiple values within the same dimension are combined with OR. Supported dimensions: tags (one or more of [Life, Food, Beauty, Entertainment, Travel, Tech, Business, Vehicle, Health, Family, Pets, Knowledge]).

input_schema.name: filter_exclude
input_schema.description: Negative filter conditions. Items matching these conditions will be excluded. Supported dimensions: tags, id.

nodes.name: Search Web Topic
nodes.description: Web topic retrieval (2026-11-14 依赖约简阶段5:每轮必跑,与模板推荐并行 fan-out,经 [template_recommendation, search_web_topic]→generate_script 双源屏障汇入;历史:2026-11-10 前置化为条件路由节点)。检索开关关闭或检索词为空时节点内部软跳过(只落 skipped 标签,不发网络请求、不写产物);检索词 = 手动 query + 画面概述首句 + 分组主题自动构造;结果软降级,失败不阻断文案。

nodes.name: Generate Script
nodes.description: Generate script/subtitles for each group; supports passing a custom_script override. 入边 = [模板推荐, 网页检索] 双源屏障(2026-11-14 依赖约简阶段5:两分支并行 fan-out 后汇入,原条件路由删除);fan-out 派生配音、文字推荐(2026-11-14 依赖约简:BGM 与时间线不再把文案列为直接屏障来源,由配音/转场/文字链传递保证)。

input_schema.name: mode
input_schema.description: auto: Generate appropriate script based on media content and user's script requirements; skip: Skip, do not add subtitles; default: Use default script

input_schema.name: user_request
input_schema.description: User's requirements for the script.

input_schema.name: custom_script
input_schema.description: If user has specific character-level editing requirements for script/title, pass the edited custom script and title through this parameter. Format should be based on the original script generation output format but with the subtitle_units field removed. In this case, mode must use `auto`, other modes are prohibited.

output_schema.name: group_scripts
output_schema.description: Group-level script content including subtitle units

nodes.name: Generate Voiceover
nodes.description: Generate voiceover/narration items (e.g., TTS) for each group. TTS 整体失败不写 artifact(配音/字幕解耦);成功产物含各段 duration,是 BGM 时长覆盖偏好与时间线配音轨的真实输入。

input_schema.name: mode
input_schema.description: auto: Generate appropriate voiceover based on media content and user's voice requirements; skip: Skip voiceover; default: Use default voiceover

input_schema.name: user_request
input_schema.description: User's requirements for voiceover.

nodes.name: Select BGM
nodes.description: Select appropriate background music (BGM) based on material content and user requirements. 由 generate_voiceover 单源边触发(2026-11-14 依赖约简:配音已等文案,文案来源属重复约束;2026-11-13 任务B 的配音消费保留 —— 真实聚合配音 artifact 各段 duration(voiceover_total_ms)作为配乐时长覆盖偏好);配音缺失按 0 容缺省,BGM 不因配音失败陪葬。2026-11-14 BGM 选曲改造:曲库来源改为本机剪映云音乐索引(harvest 自真实草稿素材,空库回退 YAML 占位库);LLM 候选白名单投影(禁 path/cache_path/request_id/raw_material);stub=素材不可用,与选择策略 method/selection_source 解耦。云音乐模式(selection 含 music_id)下 CanonicalTimeline.audio.bgm_ref=None —— mapper 不再生成 bgm-1 占位,真实音轨由 node_05 generate_draft 在原生写盘前自动铺入(JY_AUTO_BGM 开关,关卡② 仅有 BGM 缺失时挂起)。

input_schema.name: mode
input_schema.description: auto: Select appropriate music based on media content and user's music requirements; skip: Do not use music; default: Use default music

input_schema.name: user_request
input_schema.description: User's requirements for background music.

input_schema.name: filter_include
input_schema.description: Positive filter conditions. Supported dimensions: mood [Dynamic, Chill, Happy, Sorrow, Romantic, Calm, Excited, Healing, Inspirational]; scene [Vlog, Travel, Relaxing, Emotion, Transition, Outdoor, Cafe, Evening, Scenery, Food, Date, Club]; genre [Pop, BGM, Electronic, R&B/Soul, Hip Hop/Rap, Rock, Jazz, Folk, Classical, Chinese Style]; lang [bgm, en, zh, ko, ja]; id (int).

input_schema.name: filter_exclude
input_schema.description: Negative filter conditions. Items matching these conditions will be excluded. Supported dimensions: mood, scene, genre, lang, id.

output_schema.name: bgm
output_schema.description: storyline_bgm_selection: bgm_ref/beats/duration_ms/tempo/default_volume/reason/method/selection_source/stub/voiceover_total_ms/asset_available + 云音乐元数据(music_id/music_name/category_id/category_name/asset_kind);云音乐模式(cache_path 有效)下 stub=False 且 canonical audio.bgm_ref=None

nodes.name: Recommend Transition
nodes.description: Recommend transitions (e.g., fade in/out) at beginning and end. 由 select_bgm 单源边触发(2026-11-14 依赖约简:BGM 的祖先链已含分组节点,分组来源属重复约束);真实读取分组与 BGM selection(bgm_ref 传入能力层,当前模板未渲染该占位符,为预留字段)。

input_schema.name: mode
input_schema.description: auto: add fade in and fade out transitions at beginning and end; skip: Do not use transitions; default: Use default transitions

input_schema.name: duration
input_schema.description: Duration of the transition in milliseconds

output_schema.name: mode
output_schema.description: auto / skip / default mode (output model is BaseInput)

nodes.name: Recommend Text
nodes.description: Recommend subtitle font style/color based on user's requirements; supports include filters.

input_schema.name: mode
input_schema.description: auto: Select appropriate font style and color based on user's subtitle font style requirements; default: Use default font

input_schema.name: user_request
input_schema.description: User's requirements for font style

input_schema.name: filter_include
input_schema.description: Positive filter conditions. Supported dimensions: class [Creative, Handwriting, Calligraphy, Basic].

output_schema.name: mode
output_schema.description: auto / skip / default mode (output model is BaseInput)

nodes.name: Plan Timeline Pro
nodes.description: Plan timeline tracks for video, subtitles, voiceover, and BGM; optionally sync transitions with BGM beats. 两源 fan-in 屏障(2026-11-14 依赖约简:六源缩 [recommend_transition, recommend_text] —— 转场链传递保证分组/文案/配音/BGM/素材就绪,文字推荐单独保证文字样式;历史:2026-11-12 曾扩为六源);AI 开启时出边交给 plan_timeline_ai_transition,AI 关闭时直接进 qa_gate。

input_schema.name: mode
input_schema.description: auto: Automatic mode; skip: Skip mode; default: Default mode

input_schema.name: use_beats
input_schema.description: Whether clip transitions should sync with BGM beats

nodes.name: Generate AI Transition
nodes.description: Optional AI transition generation (STORYLINE_ENABLE_AI_TRANSITION 开启时才接线;未配置/未批准 Provider 时零外呼,仅登记审计)。读取分组衔接点与普通转场提示(分组由转场推荐链传递保证,2026-11-14 依赖约简),生成衔接转场 MP4 产物。

nodes.name: Plan Timeline AI Transition
nodes.description: Merge AI transitions into the Canonical Timeline (AI 开启时接线). 校验真实生成状态/MP4 存在/两端 clip 相邻后物化为 SourceMedia + Clip;失败或未批准时保留基础时间线并留审计记录,不阻断主链。

nodes.name: QA Gate
nodes.description: QA on the final Canonical Timeline(合约/源区间/速度/目标时长)。入边二选一:AI 开启等 plan_timeline_ai_transition,AI 关闭直等 plan_timeline_pro。条件出口:时长超限且仍可重试 → 回 group_clips(重试回路);通过/空计划/非时长错误/重试耗尽 → join_storyline。

nodes.name: Join Storyline
nodes.description: Hand the Canonical Timeline over as storyline_plan. 条件出口:存在有效 plan → 外层 generate_draft 主流程;无可用计划 → END(不生成空草稿)。

nodes.name: Generate Draft (outer pipeline)
nodes.description: 外层剪映草稿生成主流程的入口(不在本快照范围内)。storyline_join 交接成功后进入;本快照到此为止,外层后续节点见 /api/workflow/graph 主图视图。
